items.title: 1.11 Applications of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions in Real-Life Situations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 28-32: 1.11 intro; (i) growth and decay, Examples 22-23; (ii) decibels, Examples 24-26; (iii) discrete and continuous compound interest, Examples 27-28

blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum! Ab tak hum ne exponential aur logarithmic functions ki shakal, un ke graphs aur un ki equations dekhi hain. Is sabaq mein hum dekhenge ke yeh functions asal zindagi mein kahan kaam aate hain. Teen misalein lenge: aabadi ka barhna aur radioactive cheez ka ghatna (growth and decay), awaaz ki shiddat ko decibel mein naapna (sound intensity), aur bank mein paisa barhna (compound interest).

Kitab yeh baat saaf batati hai: exponential models un cheezon ko describe karte hain jo waqt ke saath badalti hain, aur logarithmic functions in models mein chhupi hui unknown cheez (jaise waqt ya rate) dhoondne mein madad karte hain. Growth and decay ka formula yahan ek diya hua model samajh kar istemal hoga; is ko hum aage differential equations wale chapter mein derive karenge (yani khud bana kar dekhenge). Sound intensity aur compound interest ke formulas standard results ke taur par liye jayenge, yahan derive nahi honge.

Is sabaq ka naqsha yeh hai: har hisse mein pehle kitab ka formula aayega, phir hum samjhenge ke yeh formula kyun aur kab lagta hai, aur phir kitab ki misalein qadam ba qadam hal karenge. Aap ko formulas ratne nahi, pehchanne hain: sawal parh kar foran pata chal jana chahiye ke kaunsa model lagega aur unknown kahan chhupa hai. Agar unknown power mein ho to logarithm hamara sab se bara hathiyar hai, aur agar logarithm ke andar ho to exponential form hamara hathiyar hai. Yeh do ulti chaabiyan is poore sabaq ki jaan hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is page ka har sawal ek hi saanche mein dhala hai: ek formula (model) kisi cheez ko waqt ya intensity se jorta hai.
Agar unknown khud woh cheez ho (jaise final amount), to bas values rakhiye aur calculate kar lijiye. Yeh aasan wala case hai.
Lekin agar unknown power (exponent) mein baitha ho, jaise waqt \(t\) ya constant \(k\), to seedha nahi nikalta. Pehle exponential wale hisse ko akela karte hain, phir dono taraf logarithm lete hain. Logarithm ki khoobi yeh hai ke woh power ko neeche utaar deta hai:
\[\ln(e^{x}) = x\]
\[\log(10^{x}) = x\]
\[\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\]
Yaad rakhiye: base \(e\) ho to \(\ln\) (natural log) lijiye, aur base 10 ho to \(\log\) (common log, base 10). Jaise taala usi chaabi se khulta hai jo us ke liye bani ho, waise hi \(e\) ki power \(\ln\) se aur 10 ki power \(\log\) se utarti hai.
(i) Growth and Decay

Qudrat mein bahut se amal (processes) aise hain, jaise aabadi ka barhna (population growth) aur radioactive decay (radioactive maadde ka khud ba khud toot kar kam hona), jin mein tabdeeli ki raftaar (rate of change) us waqt mojood miqdaar ke proportional (mutanasib) hoti hai. Yani jitni zyada cheez, utni tez tabdeeli. Aise amal ko exponential growth ya exponential decay kehte hain.
Is ka aam mathematical model yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: N equals N nought times e to the power k t

blocks.text: Yahan \(N_0\) shuru ki miqdaar (initial amount) hai, \(N\) waqt \(t\) par miqdaar hai, aur \(k\) ek constant hai jo growth mein positive aur decay mein negative hota hai.
Growth mein miqdaar waqt ke saath barhti hai aur decay mein ghatti hai. In models mein unknown cheezein, jaise waqt ya rate, logarithm ki madad se nikali jati hain.

Is formula ko ek dafa aaram se parhte hain. Is mein chaar cheezein hain: \(N_0\) (shuru ki miqdaar), \(N\) (baad ki miqdaar), \(t\) (waqt) aur \(k\) (rate constant). Har sawal mein in mein se teen cheezein di jati hain aur chauthi poochi jati hai. Agar \(N\) poocha ho to sirf values rakh kar calculator chalana hai. Agar \(t\) ya \(k\) poocha ho to woh power mein phansa hua hai, aur use bahar nikalne ke liye \(\ln\) chahiye. Aur haan, \(e\) koi variable nahi, ek fixed number hai, taqreeban 2.718, bilkul jaise \(\pi\) taqreeban 3.142 hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(N_0\) shuru ki miqdaar kyun hai? \(t = 0\) rakh kar dekhiye: \(N = N_0e^{0} = N_0 \times 1 = N_0\). Yani bilkul shuru mein (waqt zero par) jo miqdaar thi, wohi \(N_0\) hai.
\(k\) ka sign kyun faisla karta hai? Agar \(k > 0\) ho to \(t\) barhne se \(e^{kt}\) bara hota jata hai, yani growth. Agar \(k < 0\) ho to \(e^{kt}\) chhota hota jata hai aur zero ke qareeb jata hai magar kabhi zero nahi hota, yani decay.
'Rate proportional to current amount' ko aise samjhiye: jis shehar mein log zyada hain wahan bachche bhi zyada paida hote hain, is liye aabadi aur tezi se barhti hai. Bilkul isi tarah bank mein zyada paisa ho to munafa bhi zyada milta hai.
Jab \(t\) ya \(k\) unknown ho to chaar qadam: (1) maloom values rakhiye, (2) divide kar ke \(e^{(\dots)}\) ko akela kijiye, (3) dono taraf \(\ln\) lijiye, (4) jo seedhi si equation bachi use hal kijiye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar \(N = 50e^{-0.3t}\) ho to yeh growth hai ya decay? Aur \(t = 0\) par miqdaar kitni hai? (Jawab: \(k = -0.3\) negative hai, is liye decay; aur \(t = 0\) par \(N = 50\).)

Chaliye ab kitab ki pehli misaal karte hain. Ek baat pehle se zehan mein rakhiye: humein aabadi double hone ka waqt chahiye, yani 200 se 400. Waqt power mein hai, is liye aakhir mein logarithm zaroor aayega. Pehle khud koshish kijiye, phir neeche wale qadmon se milaiye.

blocks.title: Example 22
blocks.problem: A population is given by: \(N = 200e^{0.04t}\). Find the time \(t\) when the population becomes 400, where \(t\) is measured in hours. (Growth)
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 200e^{0.04t}\) aur \(N = 400\).
Maloom karna: waqt \(t\) (ghanton mein).
Tareeqa: sab se pehle dekhte hain ke unknown kahan hai. \(t\) power mein baitha hai, is liye seedha nahi nikal sakta. Pehle \(N = 400\) rakhenge, phir \(e^{0.04t}\) ko akela karenge, aur phir natural logarithm \(\ln\) lenge, kyunke base \(e\) hai.

\(N = 400\) rakhein
\[400 = 200e^{0.04t}\]
Kyun: model har lamhe sahi hai, us lamhe bhi jab aabadi 400 ho jati hai. Is liye \(N\) ki jagah 400 likh diya.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{400}{200} = e^{0.04t}\]
\[2 = e^{0.04t}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 200 se divide kiya to right side par sirf \(e^{0.04t}\) bacha. Yeh qadam zaroori hai, kyunke jab tak 200 saath multiply ho raha hai, \(\ln\) lene se seedha \(0.04t\) nahi milta.
Dhyan dein: bahut se students \(\ln(200e^{0.04t})\) ko \(0.04t\) likh dete hain. Yeh ghalat hai; asal mein yeh \(\ln 200 + 0.04t\) hai.

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[\ln 2 = \ln(e^{0.04t})\]
\[\ln 2 = 0.04t\]
Kyun: \(\ln\) aur \(e\) ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain, \(\ln(e^{x}) = x\). Is tarah \(t\) power se neeche aa gaya aur ab ek seedhi equation hai.

\(t\) nikaalein
\[t = \dfrac{\ln 2}{0.04}\]
\[= \dfrac{0.6931}{0.04}\]
\[\approx 17.33\]
Kyun: dono taraf 0.04 se divide kiya. Calculator se \(\ln 2 \approx 0.6931\).

Tasdeeq:
\[200e^{0.04 \times 17.33} = 200e^{0.6932}\]
\[\approx 200 \times 2.000 = 400\]
Jawab wapas model mein rakha to aabadi 400 aayi. Jawab sahi hai.
blocks.answer: Aabadi taqreeban \(17.33\) ghanton mein 400 ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 23
blocks.problem: A radioactive substance decays according to: \(N = 500e^{kt}\). After 20 hours, the amount becomes 300. Find the value of \(k\), where \(t\) is in hours. (Decay)
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 500e^{kt}\); \(t = 20\) par \(N = 300\).
Maloom karna: constant \(k\).
Tareeqa: is dafa unknown \(k\) hai aur woh bhi power mein hai. Dono maloom values rakhenge, \(e^{20k}\) ko akela karenge, aur \(\ln\) lenge.

\(t = 20\) aur \(N = 300\) rakhein
\[300 = 500e^{20k}\]
Kyun: 20 ghante baad miqdaar 300 hai, yani yeh jora model ko poora karta hai.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{300}{500} = e^{20k}\]
\[\dfrac{3}{5} = e^{20k}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 500 se divide kiya aur fraction ko chhota kiya (dono ko 100 se).

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[\ln\left(\dfrac{3}{5}\right) = 20k\]
Kyun: \(\ln(e^{20k}) = 20k\); power neeche aa gayi.

\(k\) nikaalein
\[k = \dfrac{1}{20}\ln\left(\dfrac{3}{5}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{-0.51083}{20}\]
\[\approx -0.02554\]
Kyun: 20 se divide kiya. \(\frac{3}{5}\) ek se chhota hai, aur ek se chhote number ka \(\ln\) hamesha negative hota hai. Is liye \(k\) negative aaya, jo decay ke liye bilkul theek hai.
Dhyan dein: chaar decimal tak round karein to \(-0.025541\) ka paanchwan digit 4 hai, is liye jawab \(-0.0255\) banta hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[500e^{20 \times (-0.02554)} = 500e^{-0.5108}\]
\[\approx 500 \times 0.6000 = 300\]
20 ghante baad 300 aaya, aur \(k < 0\) decay se milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 23 mein kitab ne do jagah \(k \approx -0.0256\) likha hai. Asal value \(k = \frac{1}{20}\ln\frac{3}{5} = -0.025541\ldots\) hai, jo chaar decimal tak \(-0.0255\) banti hai (paanchwan digit 4 hai, is liye neeche round hota hai). Tareeqa bilkul sahi hai, sirf aakhri digit ki rounding ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Doubling time aur half-life: growth model tab double hota hai jab \(e^{kt} = 2\), yani \(t = \frac{\ln 2}{k}\) par, chahe shuru mein kitna bhi ho. Example 22 mein \(\frac{\ln 2}{0.04} \approx 17.33\) ghante: bilkul wahi jawab, kyunke 400, 200 ka double hai.
Isi tarah decay model \(t = \frac{\ln 2}{|k|}\) par aadha ho jata hai; isay half-life (aadhi umar) kehte hain. Exam mein 'double' ya 'half' ka lafz dekhte hi yeh shortcut yaad kijiye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahi: ek bacteria culture \(N = 80e^{0.1t}\) (\(t\) ghanton mein) ke mutabiq barhta hai. Kitne ghante mein 240 ho jayega?
\(240 = 80e^{0.1t}\), to \(3 = e^{0.1t}\), to \(\ln 3 = 0.1t\), to \(t = \frac{\ln 3}{0.1} \approx 10.99\) ghante.
Tasdeeq: \(80e^{1.099} \approx 80 \times 3.001 \approx 240\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ab decay ki ek practice (yeh bhi hamari taraf se, kitab ka sawal nahi): ek radioactive maadda \(N = 1000e^{-0.1t}\) (\(t\) ghanton mein) ke mutabiq ghatta hai. Is ki half-life kya hai, aur 10 ghante baad kitna bachega?
Half-life: \(t = \frac{\ln 2}{0.1} \approx 6.93\) ghante. Yani har taqreeban 7 ghante mein maadda aadha reh jata hai.
10 ghante baad: \(N = 1000e^{-0.1 \times 10} = 1000e^{-1} \approx 367.88\).
Ghor kijiye: yahan unknown \(N\) tha, power mein nahi, is liye logarithm ki zaroorat hi nahi pari. Sirf values rakh kar calculate kar liya.
(ii) Sound Intensity (Decibels)

Awaaz ki intensity (shiddat) us sound energy ki miqdaar hai jo har second ek unit area (maslan ek square meter) se guzarti hai. Awaaz ki intensity bahut hi bari range mein badalti hai, is liye isay ek logarithmic scale par naapte hain jise decibel (dB) scale kehte hain.
Sound level \(L\) is formula se milta hai:

blocks.text_alt: L equals 10 times log of I over I nought

blocks.text: Yahan \(I\) awaaz ki intensity hai aur \(I_0\) threshold of hearing hai, yani woh sab se halki awaaz jo ek aam insaani kaan sun sakta hai. Is ki standard value yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: I nought equals 10 to the power minus 12 watts per square metre

blocks.text: \(\text{W/m}^{2}\) (watts per square meter) sound intensity ki unit hai. Yeh batati hai ke har second (energy per second, yani power) kitni sound energy ek unit area se guzar rahi hai.

Logarithmic scale ki wajah se decibels mein thora sa izafa bhi asal intensity mein bahut bari tabdeeli dikhata hai. Isi liye logarithm ke qawaneen asal zindagi mein awaazon ka muqabla karne mein bahut kaam aate hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yahan \(\log\) ka matlab common logarithm (base 10) hai, \(\ln\) nahi. Yeh sab se zaroori baat hai.
Logarithmic scale kyun? Jo awaazein hum sun sakte hain un ki intensity \(10^{-12}\) se le kar taqreeban \(1\ \text{W/m}^{2}\) tak hoti hai, yani laakhon karoron guna farq. Itne bare numbers ke saath kaam mushkil hai; logarithm is poori range ko 0 se 120 dB jaise aasan numbers mein badal deta hai. Jaise naqshe par hazaron kilometer ko chand centimeter mein dikha dete hain.
Do baatein yaad rakhiye: threshold par \(I = I_0\), to \(L = 10\log 1 = 0\) dB. Aur har 10 dB izafe par intensity 10 guna ho jati hai, kyunke \(\frac{I}{I_0} = 10^{L/10}\). Maslan 60 dB ki baat cheet aur 90 dB ki traffic mein 30 dB farq hai, yani intensity \(10 \times 10 \times 10 = 1000\) guna.
\(L\) se \(I\) nikalna ho to: pehle 10 se divide kijiye, phir exponential form mein likhiye, kyunke \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\) hai.

Ab decibel formula ki teen misalein aati hain. Pehli mein intensity di hai aur level poocha hai, doosri mein level diya hai aur intensity poochi hai, aur teesri mein do awaazon ka muqabla hai. Teeno ko dhyan se dekhiye, kyunke exam mein bhi yahi teen qismein aati hain, aur har ek ka tareeqa thora mukhtalif hai.

blocks.title: Example 24
blocks.problem: A sound has intensity \(I = 10^{-4}\) and reference intensity \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\). Find the sound level. (Finding sound level)
steps:
Diya gaya: \(I = 10^{-4}\), \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\) (dono \(\text{W/m}^{2}\) mein).
Maloom karna: sound level \(L\), decibel mein.
Tareeqa: yeh seedha substitution ka sawal hai. \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\) mein values rakhenge. Ratio ko law of exponents \(\frac{10^{a}}{10^{b}} = 10^{a-b}\) se chhota karenge, aur aakhir mein \(\log(10^{x}) = x\) lagayenge.

Values rakhein
\[L = 10\log\left(\dfrac{10^{-4}}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: upar \(I = 10^{-4}\) aur neeche \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\). Dhyan rahe ke \(I_0\) hamesha neeche jata hai.

Ratio ko simplify karein
\[\dfrac{10^{-4}}{10^{-12}} = 10^{-4-(-12)}\]
\[= 10^{8}\]
\[L = 10\log(10^{8})\]
Kyun: same base ki powers divide hon to exponents minus hote hain. Minus ka minus plus ban jata hai: \(-4 + 12 = 8\).
Dhyan dein: \(-4 - (-12)\) ko \(-16\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Logarithm lein
\[L = 10 \times 8\]
\[= 80\ \text{dB}\]
Kyun: \(\log\) ka base 10 hai, is liye \(\log(10^{8}) = 8\).

Tasdeeq:
\[10^{80/10} = 10^{8} = \dfrac{I}{I_0}\]
80 dB ka matlab hai awaaz threshold se \(10^{8}\) guna zyada intense hai, aur \(10^{-4} \div 10^{-12}\) bhi \(10^{8}\) hi hai. Sahi!

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 24 ke hal mein kitab ne likha hai 'Substituting, \(I = 10^{-4}\) and \(I = 10^{-12}\)'. Doosri value asal mein reference intensity hai, is liye sahi line yeh hai: \(I = 10^{-4}\) aur \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\). Baqi hal aur jawab 80 dB bilkul sahi hain.

blocks.title: Example 25
blocks.problem: A sound has level \(L = 60\) dB and \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\). Find the intensity \(I\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(L = 60\) dB, \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\).
Maloom karna: intensity \(I\).
Tareeqa: is dafa unknown logarithm ke andar hai. Values rakhenge, 10 se divide karenge, aur phir logarithmic form ko exponential form mein badlenge, taa ke \(I\) bahar aa jaye.

Formula mein values rakhein
\[60 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\) mein \(L\) aur \(I_0\) rakh diye.

Dono taraf 10 se divide karein
\[6 = \log\left(\dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\]
Kyun: exponential form mein badalne se pehle logarithm ko akela hona chahiye, bilkul jaise pehle hum exponential ko akela karte the.

Exponential form mein badlein
\[10^{6} = \dfrac{I}{10^{-12}}\]
Kyun: \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\) hai. Yeh log ki definition hi hai: log batata hai ke 10 ki kaunsi power lagani hai.

\(I\) nikaalein
\[I = 10^{6} \times 10^{-12}\]
\[= 10^{-6}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(10^{-12}\) se multiply kiya. Same base ki powers multiply hon to exponents jama hote hain: \(6 + (-12) = -6\).

Tasdeeq:
\[10\log\left(\dfrac{10^{-6}}{10^{-12}}\right) = 10\log(10^{6})\]
\[= 60\ \text{dB}\]
Wapas 60 dB aaya, jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Example 26
blocks.problem: The sound levels at two points are \(L_1 = 90\) dB and \(L_2 = 60\) dB. Find the ratio of their intensities \(\frac{I_1}{I_2}\), where \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\).
steps:
Diya gaya: \(L_1 = 90\) dB, \(L_2 = 60\) dB, \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\).
Maloom karna: ratio \(\frac{I_1}{I_2}\).
Tareeqa: dono awaazon ke liye alag alag decibel formula likhenge, dono ko exponential form mein badlenge, aur phir ek ko doosre se divide karenge. Divide karne se \(I_0\) cancel ho jayega.

Pehli awaaz ka formula
\[90 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_0}\right)\]
\[9 = \log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_0}\right)\]
Kyun: values rakh kar 10 se divide kiya.

Doosri awaaz ka formula
\[60 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_2}{I_0}\right)\]
\[6 = \log\left(\dfrac{I_2}{I_0}\right)\]
Kyun: wohi qadam doosre level ke liye.

Exponential form
\[\dfrac{I_1}{I_0} = 10^{9}\]
\[\dfrac{I_2}{I_0} = 10^{6}\]
Kyun: \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\).

Dono equations ko divide karein
\[\dfrac{I_1}{I_2} = \dfrac{10^{9}}{10^{6}}\]
\[= 10^{3} = 1000\]
Kyun: \(\frac{I_1/I_0}{I_2/I_0} = \frac{I_1}{I_2}\), yani \(I_0\) upar neeche se cancel ho gaya. Is liye ratio ke liye \(I_0\) ki value ki zaroorat hi nahi thi. Powers divide hon to exponents minus: \(9 - 6 = 3\).

Tasdeeq:
Dono levels mein 30 dB ka farq hai, yani 10 dB ke teen qadam. Har qadam par intensity 10 guna, to \(10 \times 10 \times 10 = 1000\). Wohi jawab!
blocks.answer: \(\frac{I_1}{I_2} = 10^{3} = 1000\); pehli awaaz doosri se 1000 guna zyada intense hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Do awaazon ka muqabla karne ka shortcut: dono formulas ko minus karein to milta hai
\[L_1 - L_2 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_2}\right)\]
Example 26 mein: \(30 = 10\log\frac{I_1}{I_2}\), to \(\frac{I_1}{I_2} = 10^{3}\). Ratio nikalni ho to \(I_0\) ki kabhi zaroorat nahi parti.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar ek awaaz 70 dB aur doosri 50 dB ho to pehli doosri se kitne guna intense hai? (Jawab: farq 20 dB, to \(10^{2} = 100\) guna.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari practice: ek halki si awaaz ka level 30 dB hai. Is ki intensity kya hai?
\(30 = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\), 10 se divide: \(3 = \log\left(\frac{I}{10^{-12}}\right)\).
Exponential form: \(\frac{I}{10^{-12}} = 10^{3}\), to \(I = 10^{3} \times 10^{-12} = 10^{-9}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\).
Tasdeeq: \(10\log\left(\frac{10^{-9}}{10^{-12}}\right) = 10\log(10^{3}) = 30\) dB. Sahi! Ghor kijiye ke tareeqa bilkul Example 25 wala hai: 10 se divide, phir exponential form, phir multiply.
(iii) Compound Interest

Compound interest (sood dar sood) interest nikalne ka woh tareeqa hai jis mein har period ka kamaya hua interest principal (asal raqam) mein jama kar diya jata hai. Is tarah agle period mein interest asal raqam par bhi milta hai aur pichle jama shuda interest par bhi. Is se paisa waqt ke saath exponentially barhta hai, aur banking aur financial systems mein investment ki growth ka model isi se banaya jata hai. Compound interest ki do qismein hain: discrete compounding aur continuous compounding.
Discrete Compound Interest

Discrete compound interest mein interest muqarrara waqfon (fixed intervals) par principal mein jama hota hai, jaise saalana (yearly), chhe maahi (half-yearly), teen maahi (quarterly) ya maahana (monthly). Yahan interest har lamhe nahi, sirf in khaas waqfon par jama hota hai, aur future amount ek fixed compounding frequency se nikala jata hai. Is se bhi paisa exponentially barhta hai, aur banks mein aam taur par yahi tareeqa chalta hai.
Discrete compound interest ka formula yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: A equals P times open bracket 1 plus r over n close bracket to the power n t

items: \(r\) = har unit time ka interest rate (decimal mein)
\(n\) = ek unit time mein kitni dafa interest jama hota hai
\(t\) = waqt (usi unit mein jis mein compounding period hai)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh formula kahan se aaya? Har compounding period mein rate \(\frac{r}{n}\) hota hai, is liye har period ke baad raqam \(1 + \frac{r}{n}\) se multiply ho jati hai. \(t\) saal mein \(nt\) periods hain, to \(nt\) dafa multiply karna parta hai. Yahi power \(nt\) hai.
Chhoti si misaal: Rs. 1000, 10% saalana compound. Ek saal baad \(1000 \times 1.1 = 1100\), do saal baad \(1100 \times 1.1 = 1210\), jo \(1000(1.1)^{2}\) hi hai. Doosre saal 100 nahi, 110 interest mila, kyunke pichle saal ke 100 par bhi interest laga. Yahi 'sood dar sood' hai.
\(n\) ki values: annually 1, half-yearly 2, quarterly 4, monthly 12.
Rate hamesha decimal mein likhiye: \(8\% = \frac{8}{100} = 0.08\).
Agar waqt \(t\) unknown ho to dono taraf logarithm lijiye aur \(\ln(a^{t}) = t\ln a\) se \(t\) ko neeche utariye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari practice: Rs. 2000 par 6% saalana rate hai, half-yearly compound, 2 saal ke liye. Aakhri raqam?
Yahan \(n = 2\), to har chhe mahine ka rate \(\frac{0.06}{2} = 0.03\), aur periods \(nt = 2 \times 2 = 4\).
\(A = 2000(1.03)^{4} \approx 2000 \times 1.125509 \approx 2251.02\).
Sab se pehle hamesha yeh do cheezein nikaliye: ek period ka rate aur periods ki kul tadaad. Baqi kaam calculator ka hai.
Continuous Compound Interest

Continuous compound interest mein yeh maana jata hai ke interest har lamhe, musalsal (continuously), principal mein jama ho raha hai. Yahan koi fixed waqfa nahi hota aur raqam aahista aahista hamwar tareeqe se barhti hai. Yeh discrete compounding ka limiting case hai, yani jab compounding periods ki tadaad be-hadd bari (infinitely large) ho jaye.
Continuous compounding ka formula yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: A equals P times e to the power r t

items: jahan \(A\) = waqt \(t\) ke baad aakhri raqam (principal + interest)
\(P\) = principal (invest ki hui ya udhaar li hui shuru ki raqam)
\(r\) = har unit time ka interest rate (decimal mein)
\(t\) = waqt (usi unit mein jis par rate based hai, jaise saal ya mahine)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
'Limiting case' ka matlab: compounding ko zyada se zyada baar kijiye (\(n\) bara, aur bara), to \(P\left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\) ek khaas value \(Pe^{rt}\) par ja kar ruk jata hai. Neeche wali table Rs. 1000, 5% saalana, 3 saal ke liye yahi dikhati hai: raqam barhti hai magar thora thora, aur aakhir \(1000e^{0.15}\) par tham jati hai.
Is liye continuous compounding hamesha usi rate ki kisi bhi discrete compounding se thora sa zyada deti hai, lekin bahut zyada nahi.

blocks.caption: Teaching table (ours): Rs. 1000 at 5% per year for 3 years

blocks.text: Ab compound interest ki kitab wali do misalein dekhte hain. Pehli continuous compounding ki hai aur doosri quarterly (discrete) compounding ki. Dono mein sab se pehla kaam yeh pehchanna hai ke sawal mein kaunsa lafz likha hai: 'continuously' ya 'quarterly'. Isi ek lafz se formula badal jata hai, is liye sawal ko jaldi mein mat parhiye.

blocks.title: Example 27
blocks.problem: A sum of Rs. 1000 is invested at a rate of 5% per year compounded continuously for 3 years. Find the final amount.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P = 1000\), \(r = 5\% = 0.05\), \(t = 3\).
Maloom karna: aakhri raqam \(A\).
Tareeqa: sawal mein 'compounded continuously' likha hai, yahi ishara hai ke \(A = Pe^{rt}\) lagana hai.

Continuous compound interest ka formula
\[A = Pe^{rt}\]
Kyun: interest har lamhe jama ho raha hai, is liye discrete wala formula nahi chalega.

Values rakhein
\[A = 1000e^{0.05 \times 3}\]
\[A = 1000e^{0.15}\]
Kyun: \(rt = 0.05 \times 3 = 0.15\). Rate decimal mein liya, 5 nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{5 \times 3} = e^{15}\) likh diya to jawab karoron mein chala jayega!

Calculate karein
\[e^{0.15} \approx 1.1618\]
\[A \approx 1000 \times 1.1618\]
\[= 1161.8\]
Kyun: calculator se \(e^{0.15} = 1.16183\ldots\)

Tasdeeq:
Saalana compounding se raqam \(1000(1.05)^{3} = 1157.63\) hoti. Continuous compounding ne thora sa zyada diya, jaisa ke hona chahiye (upar wali table dekhiye).
blocks.answer: 3 saal baad aakhri raqam \(A \approx\) Rs. 1161.8 hai.

blocks.title: Example 28
blocks.problem: A sum of Rs. 5000 is invested at a rate of 8% per annum, compounded quarterly. Find the amount after 3 years.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P = 5000\), \(r = 0.08\) (8% saalana), quarterly compounding yani \(n = 4\), \(t = 3\) saal.
Maloom karna: 3 saal baad raqam \(A\).
Tareeqa: interest har teen mahine baad (fixed waqfe par) jama hota hai, is liye discrete formula \(A = P\left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\) lagega.

Discrete compound interest ka formula
\[A = P\left(1 + \dfrac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\]
Kyun: 'quarterly' ka matlab saal mein chaar dafa interest jama hona.

Values rakhein
\[A = 5000\left(1 + \dfrac{0.08}{4}\right)^{4 \times 3}\]
\[A = (5000)(1.02)^{12}\]
Kyun: har quarter ka rate \(\frac{0.08}{4} = 0.02\) hai, aur 3 saal mein \(4 \times 3 = 12\) quarters hain.
Dhyan dein: power mein sirf \(t = 3\) likhna aam ghalti hai; periods 12 hain.

Calculate karein
\[(1.02)^{12} \approx 1.268242\]
\[A \approx 5000 \times 1.268242\]
\[\approx 6341.2\]
Kyun: calculator ki power key istemal ki; rounding sirf aakhir mein ki.

Tasdeeq:
Saalana compounding se \(5000(1.08)^{3} = 6298.56\) banta. Quarterly compounding ne thora zyada diya, jaisa ke umeed thi.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Rs. 1000 par 10% saalana rate ho to ek saal ke liye monthly compounding zyada degi ya continuous? (Jawab: continuous, \(1000e^{0.1} \approx 1105.17\), jab ke monthly \(\approx 1104.71\).)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Exam mein formula kaise pehchaanein? Sawal ke alfaaz dekhiye:
'population', 'grows', 'decays', 'radioactive' aur \(e^{kt}\) wala model: growth and decay, \(N = N_0e^{kt}\).
'intensity', 'sound level', 'dB': decibel formula \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\).
'compounded annually / half-yearly / quarterly / monthly': discrete formula \(A = P\left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\).
'compounded continuously': \(A = Pe^{rt}\).
Phir doosra sawal: unknown kahan hai? Power mein ho to logarithm lijiye; logarithm ke andar ho to exponential form mein badliye; kahin na phansa ho to seedha calculate kijiye.

Aakhri baat: is sabaq ke saare sawal asal mein do ulte kaamon ki practice hain. Exponential function kisi miqdaar ko waqt ke saath barhata ya ghatata hai, aur logarithm us ka ulta kaam kar ke humein bata deta hai ke yeh sab kitne waqt mein hua ya kis rate se hua. Jab aap yeh rishta samajh lenge to Exercise 1.5 ke baarah sawal aap ko ek jaise lagenge, aur aap har sawal ko chand lines mein, sahi wajah ke saath, hal kar sakenge. Har sawal ke baad jawab ko wapas model mein rakh kar check karne ki aadat daaliye; yeh chhota sa kaam exam mein bahut se numbers bacha leta hai, kyunke ghalti foran pakri jati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Growth aur decay: \(N = N_0e^{kt}\); growth mein \(k > 0\), decay mein \(k < 0\); \(N_0\) waqt zero par miqdaar hai.
2. \(t\) ya \(k\) unknown ho to pehle exponential ko akela kijiye, phir dono taraf \(\ln\) lijiye.
3. Sound level: \(L = 10\log\left(\frac{I}{I_0}\right)\), log base 10 ka, \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^{2}\); har 10 dB par intensity 10 guna.
4. Discrete compounding: \(A = P\left(1 + \frac{r}{n}\right)^{nt}\); continuous compounding: \(A = Pe^{rt}\).
5. Rate hamesha decimal mein: \(5\% = 0.05\).
6. Doubling time \(\frac{\ln 2}{k}\), half-life \(\frac{\ln 2}{|k|}\).
7. Har jawab ko wapas model mein rakh kar check kijiye.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Divide karne se pehle \(\ln\) le lena: \(\ln(200e^{0.04t})\) ki value \(\ln 200 + 0.04t\) hai, sirf \(0.04t\) nahi.
2. Decibel formula mein \(\ln\) laga dena: wahan \(\log\) base 10 hai.
3. 8% ko 0.08 ke bajaye 8 likh dena.
4. Power mein \(n\) bhool jana: quarterly 3 saal ke liye \(nt = 12\) periods, har ek par rate 0.02.
5. Ek se chhote number ke \(\ln\) ka minus sign kho dena; is se waqt negative aa jata hai, jo mumkin nahi.
6. Jaldi round kar dena: aakhri line tak kam az kam chaar decimal rakhiye.
